body.name: Changing-contact inference handle
body.construction: Critical-cone obstacle handle: starting from the externally supplied band \(\widehat{\mathcal B}_{\eta,n}\), restrict support calibration to the finite net \(\mathcal D_n\), and at mesh \(h_n\) construct the radius-\(\mathsf R\)-clipped set \(\widehat{\mathcal T}_{n,h_n}^{+}\), \(\widehat{\mathcal P}_{X,n}\), and all \(\widehat I_G\) by a robust obstacle program that re-solves the active contact face, a Fang--Santos estimated directional derivative, and one common multiplier supremum over \(\mathcal D_n\times\mathcal G_n\).
